challenge: After selection, evaluate the same models on one alternate authored wording per held-out entity and label; do not tune on challenge results
data: Existing build_cases('test') generator; synthetic English templates only
diagnostics: After original validation selection: paired wording transitions, fixed-method leave-one-entity-out folds, 12 seeded stratified training resamples, one-family training downsampling, and feature/label-count review; exploratory, never used to select a model
method: majority versus multinomial Naive Bayes with unigram or unigram+bigram counts and Laplace smoothing

metrics.entity_variance: population variance of accuracy across test entities
metrics.label_distribution: split-normalized label fractions, unweighted mean and population variance across fixed splits, and total variation from train
metrics.macro_f1: arithmetic mean of per-family F1, including zero for absent or unpredicted families
metrics.per_label: support, predicted count, precision=TP/(TP+FP), recall=TP/(TP+FN), F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); undefined denominators reported as zero
metrics.score_margin: top minus runner-up unnormalized class log score; descriptive mean and population variance on fixed cases

question: Can lexical features classify a synthetic research question's family for unseen service entities?
selection: highest validation macro F1, then accuracy, then fixed name order; test used after selection
template_audit: Exact question-template overlap with training after masking known service names; descriptive only and never used for model selection
